subdomain.name: Conversational Agent
subdomain.capability: Interactive chat assistant that reasons over a user's message, calls backend tools, and streams its answer in real time while remembering the conversation.
subdomain.why_distinct: Single capability named by the description (the AI chat assistant); turn handling, memory and history are cooperating contexts serving the same outcome, not separate expertise areas.

ubiquitous_language.definition: A continuous conversation thread owned by one user (and tenant).
One round-trip where the user sends a message and the agent replies.
A backend function the AI invokes during a turn to fetch data or perform an action.
The live SSE feed sending text chunks and status updates back to the client.
The recent messages (last 12 in full detail) plus a rolling summary sent to the model on each turn, within the 16,000-token limit.
Append-only log of every user message, tool call and assistant reply, with token counts.

bounded_contexts.name: Chat Session & Turn Orchestration
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Admit chat traffic per session, run each turn's agent loop with tool calls, and stream the Token Stream over SSE without blocking Netty event-loop threads.
in_scope: Session ownership by user and tenant
Cap of 5 tool calls and 30-second timeout per message, stopping cleanly and telling the user
Status updates when a tool runs
invariants: Every chat session belongs to a specific user and tenant; nobody can read or send messages into someone else's conversation (403 Forbidden)
A turn makes at most 5 tool calls and lasts at most 30 seconds; on hitting either limit it stops cleanly and informs the user
Streaming and LLM waits never block Netty event-loop threads
reads: Chat History Log (reload of past chats)

bounded_contexts.name: Conversation Memory
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Maintain the Context Window: last 12 messages in full plus a running summary of older ones, within the 16,000-token context limit.
in_scope: Keeping last 12 messages in full detail
out_of_scope: Session access enforced by Chat Session & Turn Orchestration
invariants: The Context Window holds the last 12 messages in full detail and older messages only as a running summary, never exceeding the 16,000-token limit

bounded_contexts.name: Chat History Log
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Persist every user message, tool call and assistant reply as an append-only log with token counts, for reload and usage tracking.
out_of_scope: Session access enforced by Chat Session & Turn Orchestration
invariants: History entries are append-only and each carries token counts

assumptions.item: Single subdomain: memory and history are contexts of the same chat workflow.

Event delivery and client message retries: description names no at-most-once/at-least-once posture nor a dedup identity (client key vs natural identity) for the append-only history; a retried message could be logged twice. If natural identity is used, is the mutable message payload part of it?
Unbounded quantities: tenant/role model, message size, summary length and retention of history are unspecified; left unbounded.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: None on boundaries; operator to answer.

ai_directive.quote: Users send messages in a conversation, the agent thinks through the request, calls backend tools when it needs real data or actions, and streams its answer back word by word in real time so the UI feels fast and responsive.
